content: Quiric huauquimanda ama yanga rimanguichu
Shuc chara mana sinzhi quiric runatahuas canguna quiric muntunma cushihuan yaicuchichi. Yaicuchisha pai chican catiushca yuyaimanda ama piñanguichichu.
Maicanga paiguna micunamanda chicanda yuyarinaun. Maican quiriccunaga tucuita micunallami ninaun. Shuccunaga mana sinzhi quiric asha ima aichatahuas mana micunachu ninaun.
Tucui tunu micunata micuc runaga, mana tucuita micuc runata ama piñanguichu. Chasnallata mana micuc runaga micuc runata mana balinguichu nisha mana rimanachu. Yaya Dios paitahuas japishcami.

Pitangui can shuc amuhua runamanda chasna mana alita rimangahua. Shuc amu paihua runagunata ricusha ali rashcatas mana ali rashcatas yachasha paimi yachanga. Chasna acpi shucpagmandaga mana rimanachu. Señor Jesucristoga ushaita charinmi paihua runata yanapasha alita ranga.

Punzhagunamanda chasnallata chicanda yuyariungunami. Maican quiriccunaga maican punzhata yali balichiunguna. Shuc quiriccunaga tucui punzhaguna chi tupulla balig manaun nishami yuyariunguna. Caran amu paihua shungu ucui yuyarishcatas alipacha yachasha ranami.

Maican punzhata balichic runaga Diosta balichingahuami chi punzhataga balichin. Tucui punzhaguna chi tupullatami balic an nisha rimac runahuas chasnallata Diosta balichinmi. Aichata micuc runaga Diosta balichinmi paita pagrachu nisha. Mana aichata micuc runahuas Diosta pagrachu nisha chasnallata paita balichinmi.
Tucuiguna mana ñucanchiraicullachu causanchi, huañushahuas mana ñucanchiraicullataga huañunchichu.
Causaushaga Señor Jesucristoraicumi causaunchi, huañushaga Señor Jesucristoraicumi huañunchi. Chasna ashaga huañuibis, causaibis Señor Jesucristohuac manchi.
Chiraicumandami Cristoga huañushcamanda cuti causarira tucui causac runagunatas huañushca runagunatahuas mandac tucungahua.

Chasna acpi imahuacta camba quiric huauquitaga mana alichan nishaga rimangui, imahuacta paitaga mana balichingui. Shuc punzha tucui ñucanchi Diospa ñaupacpi shayarina manchi pai taripashca tucungahua.
Chimanda Diospa shimibi casna quillcashcami tiyan:

content.text: Jatun Dios casna nin, Ñáuca causac Dios ashcamandami tucui runaguna ñuca ñaupacpi cunguringaunami.
Tucuigunami ñucata jatun Dios mangui nishami rimahuangauna.

content: Chasna acpi ñucanchiga tucuigunami Diospa ñaupacpi caran amu imasna rasha causashcata rimangaraunchi.
Quiric huauquita mana pandachinachu.
Chita yachasha quiricpurallata shuca mana alitachu raun nisha rimanata saquichi. Astahuanbas shuc quiric huauquita ama mictiachishcacuinta juchaibi urmachichichu.

Ñáucaga Señor Jesucristota quiric ashami alita yachani. Chasna acpimi yachani micunahuas imahuas mana imatahuas jiridsayachinzhu. Astahuan maican runa imatas jiridsami nisha yuyaricpimi sirtu paihuacpi jiridsa tucun.

Can chita yachashallata chi camba quiric huauqui chaita mana micuna chanchi nishcata can micushaga paita huaglichinguimi. Can chasna rashaga paita mana llaquiunguichu. Paimandas Cristo huañushca agllaita imahuacta pai cuti juchai urmachinata munangui.
Canguna rashcaguna ali man nisha yuyarishcamanda pigunahuas ama mana alitaga rimanauchun.

Diospa ali mandanai auc runagunaga mana yuyarinachan upinatas micunatas, mana upina micunagunamandachu Dioshuanga ali tucunchi. Astahuanbas paihuan ali tucusha nishaga paihua Samai yanapashcamandami ali purinataga ushanchi, mana manzhasha cushihuan causanatahuas.
Maican runa chasna rashami Cristota uyasha causasha Diosta cushiyachinga, runagunahuanbas ali maunguna nishca tucungaunami.
Chasna acpi shuccunahuan alita causanatami yuyarisha causashun. Tucui sinzhi quiric tucungahua pariumanda yuyarisha yanapanacushun.
Shuc quiric huauquihuacpi Dios rashcata ama huaglichinguichichu ima micunamandahuas. Tucui micunaga alimi. Chasna acpi can micushcamanda shuccuna pandacpiga canmi caudsayangui.
Cai rashcaga ali man: aichata sasina, binilluta sasina, imatahuas sasinami camba quiric huauquita ama pandachisha juchai urmachingahua.
Chigunamanda can imatas yuyarisha Diospacpi canlla yuyarina mangui. Maican runa ranamanda amullata mana culpayachisha causashaga cushi man.
Astahuanbas maican runas mana sirtu yachashcamanda, aichata micushachu, manachu micusha, nisha yuyarisha micushaga culpayuc tucun. Imata rashas alimi nisha ranata mana sirtu yachashaga jucha man.
